heading: My training at Laboratoria
intro1: I went from chemistry labs to writing my first line of JavaScript at Laboratoria, an intensive web development bootcamp.
intro2: There I learned the fundamentals that still support my work today: JavaScript, React, Node.js, Git, REST APIs, and apps with Firebase, building projects end-to-end, each one more complex than the last.
